validation_scope.interpretation: Union of recorded camera/FK workspace samples from independent board sessions; joint bounds alone do not prove all combinations. This board plane belongs only to the latest session; parent planes remain in provenance.
validation_scope.image_domain_interpretation: Mathematical lens invertibility is not empirical accuracy outside sampled pixels.

validation_scope.interpretation: Combined camera/FK verified on withheld board views, not global robot geometry; joint bounds alone do not prove all combinations.
validation_scope.board_print_scale: declared square size; print at 100 percent and check a physical ruler

parent_profile.uncertainty_interpretation: Empirical heldout maxima within sampled workspace; focal uncertainty is training linearized standard deviation; not guaranteed error bounds or print-scale verification.

uncertainty_interpretation: Maximum of parent and new empirical residual for the same frozen camera/FK estimator; the parent floor is retained and the two total-error estimates are not added. Relative-camera errors use same-board pairs containing heldout poses; unmeasured cross-session pairs are not validated. Focal uncertainty unchanged. Approximate sampled-workspace accuracy, not guaranteed error bounds or grasp-ready clearance.

max(parent, current empirical residual); no sum because both describe the same combined camera/FK error. Focal term is training linearized precision, not a physical bound. Approximate sampled-workspace error, not guaranteed bounds or grasp clearance.

validation.optics_interpretation: Fixed K/distortion with one fitted board pose per image: checks local optical consistency, not a new intrinsic calibration.
validation.interpretation: Only shared T_base_board is fitted from training. Per-view PnP poses only evaluate optical/metric residuals. Accuracy is approximate; residuals combine camera, FK, measurement and stationary-board assumptions, not identified servo error or grasp clearance.
